source.author: Wielki B
source.title: GANGPLANK MATCHUPS GUIDE 14.10 by EUNE rank 2

fields: Run Fleet Footwork with Bone Plating, or First Strike if confident; he can easily kill you in lane. Buy anti-heal and Swiftness Boots, and dodge his Q sweet spots and W. Poke heavily; you can win a duel when he is around 40% health and you are full.
Take First Strike and poke her with Q and barrels. Once you have hit her with your passive auto, you can see her inside her shroud.
His range and passive make it tricky, though only a strong Akshan makes it hard. Fleet Footwork with Second Wind is the safe setup.
A skill matchup. Her passive shield does not block your passive, so reset it often and poke her down; with a small lead you can win the duel.
You can win early: take Ignite and poke him until Flash, passive auto, Q and Ignite can kill. Avoid his pull. Once he has ult, only fight after poking him below half health.
Easy: take First Strike and Cut Down, dodge his cleavers, and kill him early. Buy anti-heal but do not rush it.

Hard against a good Fiora. Poke her and only fight when she is below half health and you have anti-heal. Grasp and Bone Plating work, and you can bait her riposte with an emote-style animation cancel.
Avoid losing health and stay near or under your tower; below half health he can Flash-Q, Ignite and ult you.
Take Fleet Footwork and Second Wind and avoid his poke. You rarely win a duel unless he misplays.
A good Gwen is very hard to handle; farm near your tower. First Strike is recommended.
Dodge her E and walk out of range if it hits. Take First Strike if you dodge well, otherwise Fleet. Never fight inside her ult; with Ignite you can try to kill her before level 6.
You win with good play before she completes Blade of the Ruined King. Avoid overextending; Ignite and Plated Steelcaps help.
Take First Strike and Bone Plating, and use W to cleanse his stun. Keep poking and you win easily.
He out-damages you at range during laning, but he can be killed with careful play. Fleet Footwork with Second Wind.
Kill her before level 6, since it gets harder afterward. Do not push into her so your jungler can punish her. First Strike with Gathering Storm.
Take Fleet Footwork and Second Wind, dodge his shuriken, and poke him; if you are ahead on health you can win the duel.
Take Bone Plating, dodge his Q, watch for dives and never stay in lane on low health.
Rough early if he runs Comet. Take Second Wind and buy armor penetration.
Very hard since your W no longer cleanses his ult. Take Bone Plating and stay near your tower after level 6. If you cannot dodge his Q, stand among minions to reduce its damage.
His healing outpaces your poke, so you cannot stop him stacking. Freeze near your tower and call for your jungler.
Poke him, dodge his axe and avoid his E.
Take First Strike and Cut Down; he simply out-stats you. Dying once makes the lane hard, but if he misplays and you kill him, you can duel him later.
Take Fleet Footwork and Second Wind, poke her without overextending, and ask for ganks.
Take Bone Plating and avoid fighting during his ult unless the kill is certain. With anti-heal and two items you kill him easily.
Against a skilled Riven the lane feels unplayable; at level 6 she can kill you in seconds. Take Bone Plating and poke her down.
Fleet Footwork and Second Wind. Dodge his harpoon and do not walk up at levels 3-4 when his flamethrower hits very hard. Poke him and chase when he is low.
Take Bone Plating and avoid his E. You can W his ult; do it quickly to avoid the slam damage.
He hits hard early. W his taunt, poke him, and run First Strike with Cut Down.
A free farming lane where you can rack up very high CS.
Avoid his E and Q and respect his passive damage after death. Keep resetting your passive; take First Strike and Cut Down.
Dodge his tongue since he hits hard, and W his ult. First Strike with Cut Down.
Fleet with Second Wind or First Strike with Second Wind both work. W cleanses his blind, and with items you one-shot him.
Do not overextend; freeze near your tower. Take Bone Plating or Cut Down and buy anti-heal. Poke him but only engage when you are sure to kill him even through his ult.
With ult he can dive you, so ult yourself if needed and W his slow. Exhaust is an option.
Getting hit by his E is usually fatal. You can W his ult recast so you still get pulled but survive. Bone Plating is good.
Fleet, Second Wind and Doran's Shield. Farm without losing much health, stay near your tower, poke lightly and ask for ganks; after a few items you one-shot her.
Take Cut Down; he deals a lot of damage. Poke him, watch for dives and do not stay low when he has ult.
With Ignite at level 6 he can one-shot you, and his early game is strong. Take Bone Plating; hard but winnable.
Annoying but not hard. Bone Plating helps, bait his wind wall with an animation cancel, and you can W his ult.
Poke him down, respect his W shield during trades, and take Bone Plating.
Nearly unwinnable against a competent Yorick: his cage and E take huge chunks of health and his push is strong. You can kill him before level 6, but the lane stays very hard.
